content.comment_body: Hello [product_name] community, I am using [product_name] V7.0.30 ([version_no]) with a [product_name] ([article_no]) and I am able to upload and download code without problems. Now, I have the same [product_name] ([article_no]), but a newer one from 2013 ([version_no]), and I can't establish a connection with this updated device. I think I need a software update, but after downloading it, the software doesn't recognize the *.luf file. I would appreciate your assistance. [user_name] There's another issue as well. In the menu, I can't find the option for PC->[product_name]; only [product_name]->Card and Card->[product_name] are available. Does this mean I can't connect using the USB programming cable?

Hi, To connect to the newer [product_name], you need [product_name] V7.1.5. You can download the upgrade from [url] if the update center in [product_name] isn't working. Regarding your second question: The PC-->[product_name] option was removed from the manual several versions ago. Since [product_name] [version_no], the transfer can be automatically detected by the software, so the menu option is no longer required. Hope this helps.
Hi [user_name], Thank you, that's exactly what I suspected. Have a great day.
Hi, For anyone facing a similar issue, please visit this link to ensure your new hardware is properly recognized: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: A user struggled with software-to-hardware compatibility while trying to connect [product_name] V7.0.30 to a newer [product_name] ([article_no], [version_no]), although connection worked with older units. Problems included the software not recognizing update files and a missing menu option for direct PC connection, which is now handled automatically in newer hardware revisions. Guidance from other users clarified the need for a software update and explained interface changes.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipates seamless compatibility between current software and newly released hardware, simple recognition and handling of update files, and clear menu choices for USB cable connections.
